# S3.4d — the Hosting ABI schemas (`hh-hosting`): `HostedEvent` + I-1..I-5 validators, `proj_ABI`/`lift` over the single `HOSTED_LOWERING` column, `ConformanceRecord`/`AdapterRecord`/`ParticipantRecord` (registry opaque arms + `hosted_entries`), adapter zero, `requires_capabilities`/`requires_mediation` wired to scorecard applicability, and the `MatchSpec` enforceability AC battery (R-2.10.6⁰)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §6.6 (the `hh-hosting/1` Hosting ABI) ·
§6.4 (scorecard applicability) · §2.9 (envelopes)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/050_S3.4d__hosting-abi-schemas.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.10.6⁰**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s3.4c` (stacked) · **Stage:** 3 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all checks hermetic)
**ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0281-s3.4d-hosting-abi-schema-rulings.md`

## Summary

**The schema half of the Hosting ABI lands; the service does not.**
`hh-hosting` is a new leaf crate carrying `HostedEvent` (the opaque
participant's event envelope) with the I-1..I-5 validators — lifecycle
completeness with `ensure_terminal` synthesis of unobserved terminals,
dense sequence, extension preservation (unknown/`_`-prefixed members
round-trip verbatim, never coerced), the authority ceiling (claims above
`delegate` only on kernel-gated `intercept`/`environment` origins over
closed-schema kinds; `mediated` is inadmissible on participant/adapter
claims), and hosted stamping. Unknown hosted kinds are never dropped —
`lift` maps them to `lifecycle.hosted.native_record` with the raw kind
and payload preserved.

**One class list — the lowering is a column, not a second registry.**
`proj_ABI` reads `HOSTED_LOWERING`, a new column on `hh-ledger`'s class
table (typed kind | passthrough | hint | none), so the lowering policy is
single-sourced (CC7) and exhaustive by construction. `project` takes the
session's declared observability: `model.call.*`/`model.stream.*` —
*including* hint rows, whose `ext.source` embed would otherwise smuggle
model I/O — emit no row when `model_io` is undeclared, declared in the
`LoweringLossReport` (`observability-gated`), never silently absent.

**Records layer through the registry as opaque bodies.**
`RegistryRecord::{Participant, Adapter}` store canonical `Json` behind a
`kind`-tag gate — `hh-hosting` owns the §6.6 schemas, the registry never
re-owns them. The typed exception is `ConformanceReport.hosted_entries`:
`ConformanceRecord` derives its verdict (`drift` iff both sides concrete
and differing; `unknown`/`skipped` never coerce), the codec re-derives
and refuses authored drift, `hosted_entries` is legal only on a
`subject_kind = participant` report pinned to a registered participant,
and a version bump re-derives conformance rather than inheriting it.
`ParticipantRecord.version_identity` is derived, not authored.
**Adapter zero** is the deterministic intercepted fixture over a native
run — AC-R-2.10.6-2 lifts it and asserts `metric_view` byte-parity on
every metric inside its declared observability and `n/a{observability}`
on the rest.

**Applicability gates are now real.** `EvalRun.mediation` populates from
`ResultsRow.coordinates.mediation` (native rows are fully mediated —
the kernel owns every channel; hosted rows carry only their declared
channels); `render_cell` calls `applicability_at`, so
`requires_mediation` (`veto.permission_violation` → `mediated(effects)`),
`requires_capabilities` (`n/a{capability}` when unbound), and
`applies_to_classes` (the seven hosted-only declarations;
`duplicate_effect`/`audit_completeness` native-only) all produce typed
`n/a` — never zero, never a proxy.

**AC-R-2.10.6-6 exercises the landed `MatchSpec` gate:** a matched-cap
dimension with `unenforceable`/`advisory` enforcement refuses
`IncommensurableMatch{Unenforceable}`; interception-derived `enforced`
accepts.

## Also in this change

- `hh-ontology`: `InfraErrorFamily::Participant`, `HostingMechanism`,
  `CapabilityVerdict`, `MediationChannel`/`MediationRequirement`,
  `EnforcementLevel::parse` (additive codecs).
- `check-removability.sh`: new `removability(hosting)` arm —
  `hosting_edges = []`, the tier removes clean.

## Deferred (unchanged)

The handshake, baseline/capability verbs, probes P-01…P-16, quarantine,
hosted launch, `budget_enforcement` derivation, and Adapter A+ stay at
S4.5a; the hosted-metric folds arrive with the service (declarations are
schema now and render honest `n/a`). DF-S1.3-2 keeps OPEN — the
`≤ delegate` mint needs the vouching service.
